temporal_notes: Bioassays were conducted during the course of the study between April 2012 and March 2013.
coord_source_text: The study was conducted in the Traditional Authority of Sitola in Machinga District, surrounding the town of Liwonde (500 m above sea level; −15°3'S 35°14'E).
source_text: Phenotypic pyrethroid resistance was evaluated in the study area during the course of the study using the standard WHO tube assay with two to five days old An. funestus and An. gambiae s.l. reared from eggs or larvae
